description: NaLaScNbO₆ is Pb(Zr_(1-x)Ti_x)O3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.53 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.71 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-35°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.13 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-35°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.20 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La, one Sc, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent La, one Sc, and one Nb atom to form distorted edge-sharing OLa₂ScNb tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La, one Sc, and one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one Nb atom.
